notes.title: The Infecting 3: Lambda Transaction Update
notes.notes: Includes: Brand new expansive custom survival chapter, be the zombie mode, sandbox updates and tons of secrets![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41515245/606347cdd4acc14751faaf00ac1b2bff83f8bd59.png[/img]

notes.title: New Beginnings
notes.notes:
Running up to the release of the Lambda Transaction expansion, this update adds a new chapter to the lambda trials, a secret level unlocked by in-game achievements and a mac version.
The menu screen has also been updated, but you can choose one of the original 4 in the menu as well.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41515245/4cbf7692761afa83ccbdde0587b732eb95709da2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41515245/1f48aa241fcdaf3ad007d96defdb60d1f84e690e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41515245/aff3f96fb1bc31d7a72405b6d7d85191e8b61d69.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41515245/76c7ce86e2f9fa97a2d14e67cc23b3593259284a.png[/img]

notes.title: The Infecting 3 New Chapter COMING SOON!
notes.notes: To get you ready for the upcoming update which adds a new chapter to Custom Survival and The Lambda Trials, 16 new vehicles, 12 new characters and tons of new weapons - we gave you some nice new icons of upcoming characters.
